topics.answer: Go to the Forecast page (left sidebar under Weather) to see rainfall and temperature predictions for your municipality. The Dashboard's Weather card also shows a quick summary.
Market Prices are on your Dashboard under Information. Prices update per crop and municipality; look for the trend arrow to see if prices are rising or falling.
Open Inbox from the sidebar and click 'New' to send a message. It goes straight to your DA Admin and, if enabled, is also sent as SMS.
Go to Settings (sidebar, under Account) to update your farm profile, municipality, and contact details.
Your RSBSA number can be used to log in without a password. If you're having trouble, double check the number in Settings or message a DA officer for help.
Use the sidebar on the left: Dashboard for an overview, Forecast for weather, Market Prices and Announcements under Information, Inbox for messages, and Settings for your account.
